messages:
maria: Customer reporting 415 when they try to use SSE/streaming against /v1/rerank. They say client tried to open an event stream and then got an error. Can someone confirm if rerank ever supported streaming?

kevin: Rerank never supported streaming. It expects a single JSON POST with candidates and returns scores. 415 is "unsupported media type" — sounds like they set Content-Type: text/event-stream or similar. Ask for repro.

maria: Pasted their repro below (sanitized keys):

maria: ```
curl -v -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank' \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: text/event-stream' \\n  -d 'data: {"query":"How to reset password","candidates":["Reset via settings","Contact support"]}\n'
```

maria: Response: HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type
{
  "error": "unsupported content type: text/event-stream -- rerank only accepts application/json"
}

jordan: Yep that's the root cause. Rerank doesn't stream token-by-token. Client mixed up generation chat SSE flow with rerank.

alex: We should check two things: 1) clear customer-facing error message + doc note, 2) add a short support blurb showing the correct curl/SDK usage. I can take the docs PR if you want.

kevin: Please escalate to eng-ml to verify server logs for request-id and ensure we aren't returning ambiguous 415 bodies. We could include a hint like: 'use Content-Type: application/json; rerank does not support streaming'.

maria: I grabbed request-id from customer: req_0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7. Logs attached to ticket.

deploy-bot: Created ticket SUPPORT-45812 and assigned to kevin. SLA: 72h.

kevin: I'll triage. Quick repro I ran locally returns the same 415 and the error message is from the runtime layer. Plan: (a) add clearer message, (b) add docs example, (c) CS reply template.

maria: Customer also mentioned they tried the SDK with streaming flag enabled — we should add a guard in the SDK to raise early for rerank calls.

kevin: Good call. I'll open a small SDK issue so it fails client-side. Also adding a line in the API spec: "streaming unsupported for rerank".

alex: Docs PR: I'll add a 'Common mistakes' section with correct sample: 

alex: ```
# correct (non-streaming)
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank' \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"query":"How to reset password","candidates":["Reset via settings","Contact support"],"top_k":2}'

# response (200)
{
  "scores": [0.78, 0.22],
  "ranking": [0,1]
}
```

jordan: For the CS reply, mention no billing impact and that latency shouldn't change because rerank is still single-request. They were worried streaming failure caused extra charges. We verified no extra tokens were billed due to 415.

maria: I sent interim reply to customer with correct curl + note that their API key is safe. Asking if they used any reverse proxy that rewrote headers.

kevin: Actions: create ENG-ML ticket to update runtime error wording (ENG-ML-2337), SDK issue (SDK-1029) to validate streaming flag for rerank, DOCS PR (DOCS-891). Assignments: kevin(ENG-ML), alex(DOCS), SDK owner notified.

maria: Customer responded saying they used an SSE client lib that forces Content-Type. They've switched to a plain POST and confirmed successful 200 with scores.

kevin: Great. Closing support ticket after docs + SDK guard merged. Leaving this thread as audit for the escalation.

maria: Closing notes: new support template created and linked to SUPPORT-45812. If anyone wants to review the docs text ping alex. :thumbsup:
